cohort: The study included 19,854 mother-child dyads from Southwest China between 2019 and 2022, focusing on Chinese women older than 30.
finding: Excessive and insufficient gestational weight gain were associated with increased odds of large-for-gestational-age and small-for-gestational-age, respectively, with stronger associations primarily observed in women aged 31-34 years.
birth_weight: Adverse birth weights, categorized as large-for-gestational-age (LGA) and small-for-gestational-age (SGA).
gest_age: Gestational age was used to define large-for-gestational-age (LGA) and small-for-gestational-age (SGA) outcomes.
